infoFlag.name: DEFAULT
infoFlag.description: Initial value; resets all bits.

infoFlag.name: PSFMODEL
infoFlag.description: Source fitted with a psf model (linear or non-linear).

infoFlag.name: EXTMODEL
infoFlag.description: Source fitted with an extended-source model.

infoFlag.name: FITTED
infoFlag.description: Source fitted with non-linear model (PSF or EXT; good or bad).

infoFlag.name: FAIL
infoFlag.description: Fit (non-linear) failed (non-converge\; off-edge\; run to zero).

infoFlag.name: POOR
infoFlag.description: Fit succeeds\; but low-S/N\; high-Chisq\; or large (for PSF -- drop?).

infoFlag.name: PAIR
infoFlag.description: Source fitted with a double PSF.

infoFlag.name: PSFSTAR
infoFlag.description: Source used to define PSF model.

infoFlag.name: SATSTAR
infoFlag.description: Source model peak is above saturation.

infoFlag.name: BLEND
infoFlag.description: Source is a blend with other sources.

infoFlag.name: EXTERNAL
infoFlag.description: Source based on supplied input position.

infoFlag.name: BADPSF
infoFlag.description: Failed to get good estimate of object's PSF.

infoFlag.name: DEFECT
infoFlag.description: Source is thought to be a defect.

infoFlag.name: SATURATED
infoFlag.description: Source is thought to be saturated pixels (bleed trail).

infoFlag.name: CR_LIMIT
infoFlag.description: Source has crNsigma above limit.

infoFlag.name: EXT_LIMIT
infoFlag.description: Source has extNsigma above limit.

infoFlag.name: MOMENTS_FAILURE
infoFlag.description: Could not measure the moments.

infoFlag.name: SKY_FAILURE
infoFlag.description: Could not measure the local sky.

infoFlag.name: SKYVAR_FAILURE
infoFlag.description: Could not measure the local sky variance.

infoFlag.name: BELOW_MOMENTS_SN
infoFlag.description: Moments not measured due to low S/N.

infoFlag.name: UNDEF_1
infoFlag.description: Unused bit value.

infoFlag.name: BIG_RADIUS
infoFlag.description: Poor moments for small radius\; try large radius.

infoFlag.name: AP_MAGS
infoFlag.description: Source has an aperture magnitude.

infoFlag.name: BLEND_FIT
infoFlag.description: Source was fitted as a blend.

infoFlag.name: EXTENDED_FIT
infoFlag.description: Full extended fit was used.

infoFlag.name: EXTENDED_STATS
infoFlag.description: Extended aperture stats calculated.

infoFlag.name: LINEAR_FIT
infoFlag.description: Source fitted with the linear fit.

infoFlag.name: NONLINEAR_FIT
infoFlag.description: Source fitted with the non-linear fit.

infoFlag.name: RADIAL_FLUX
infoFlag.description: Radial flux measurements calculated.

infoFlag.name: SIZE_SKIPPED
infoFlag.description: Size could not be determined.

infoFlag.name: PEAK_ON_SPIKE
infoFlag.description: Peak lands on diffraction spike.

infoFlag.name: PEAK_ON_GHOST
infoFlag.description: Peak lands on ghost or glint.

infoFlag.name: PEAK_OFF_CHIP
infoFlag.description: Peak lands off edge of chip.

infoFlag2.name: DEFAULT
infoFlag2.description: Initial value; resets all bits.

infoFlag2.name: DIFF_WITH_SINGLE
infoFlag2.description: Difference source matched to a single positive detection.

infoFlag2.name: DIFF_WITH_DOUBLE
infoFlag2.description: Difference source matched to positive detections in both images.

infoFlag2.name: MATCHED
infoFlag2.description: Source generated based on another image (forced photometry at source location).

infoFlag2.name: ON_SPIKE
infoFlag2.description: More than 25% of (PSF-weighted) pixels land on diffraction spike.

infoFlag2.name: ON_STARCORE
infoFlag2.description: More than 25% of (PSF-weighted) pixels land on starcore.

infoFlag2.name: ON_BURNTOOL
infoFlag2.description: More than 25% of (PSF-weighted) pixels land on burntool.

infoFlag2.name: ON_CONVPOOR
infoFlag2.description: More than 25% of (PSF-weighted) pixels land on convpoor.

infoFlag2.name: PASS1_SRC
infoFlag2.description: Source detected in first pass analysis

infoFlag2.name: HAS_BRIGHTER_NEIGHBOR
infoFlag2.description: Peak is not the brightest in its footprint

infoFlag2.name: BRIGHT_NEIGHBOR_1
infoFlag2.description: Flux_negative / (r^2 flux_positive) > 1.

infoFlag2.name: BRIGHT_NEIGHBOR_10
infoFlag2.description: Flux_negative / (r^2 flux_positive) > 10.

infoFlag2.name: DIFF_SELF_MATCH
infoFlag2.description: Positive detection match is probably this source.

infoFlag2.name: SATSTAR_PROFILE
infoFlag2.description: Saturated source is modeled with a radial profile.

infoFlag2.name: ECONTOUR_FEW_PTS
infoFlag2.description: Too few points to measure the elliptical contour.

infoFlag2.name: RADBIN_NAN_CENTER
infoFlag2.description: Radial bins failed with too many NaN center bin.

infoFlag2.name: PETRO_NAN_CENTER
infoFlag2.description: Petrosian (1976)  radial bins failed with too many NaN center bin.

infoFlag2.name: PETRO_NO_PROFILE
infoFlag2.description: Petrosian (1976)  not built becaues radial bins missing.

infoFlag2.name: PETRO_INSIG_RATIO
infoFlag2.description: Insignificant measurement of  Petrosian (1976)  ratio.

infoFlag2.name: PETRO_RATIO_ZEROBIN
infoFlag2.description: Petrosian (1976)  ratio in the 0th bin (likely bad).

infoFlag2.name: EXT_FITS_RUN
infoFlag2.description: Attempted to run extended fits on this source.

infoFlag2.name: EXT_FITS_FAIL
infoFlag2.description: At least one of the model fits failed.

infoFlag2.name: EXT_FITS_RETRY
infoFlag2.description: One of the model fits was retried with new window.

infoFlag2.name: EXT_FITS_NONE
infoFlag2.description: All of the model fits failed.
